notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Blizzard Elemental.
Blizzard Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Blizzard Elemental by tapping it, creating five 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate four Elemental tokens by tapping them, adding {3}{U}.
Activate Blizzard Elemental by paying {3}{U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
